meaningful_update: Solana's earlier retained-stablecoin signal has gained actual RWA secondary-trading confirmation and independent institutional SOL-demand channels. Raydium is the clearest ecosystem-specific value-capture beneficiary of tokenized-equity flow, but RAY fails the portfolio's hard holder/control-concentration gate; SOL passes structurally but remains a HOLD because the paper portfolio is already ~10% SOL and a fresh cohort of historically selective, independently funded spot wallets is still unverified.

ecosystem_regime_evidence.interpretation: Retained stablecoin balances remain elevated across multiple checkpoints while spot DEX growth is positive and perpetual volume is contracting. This is materially cleaner than a leverage-led squeeze. Chain-level zero token incentives reduce, but do not eliminate, venue-level incentive contamination.

rwa_usage_evidence.collateral_utilization_status: No new chain-specific tokenized-equity borrowing/collateral figure independently verified this run; no collateral-utilization score awarded.
rwa_usage_evidence.interpretation: This is not just RWA issuance/AUM: approximately 23.8% of outstanding tokenized-equity value is turning over daily on a 7-day average. Holder growth is also substantial. Some adjacent StonkFun/Stocklana activity used rewards/incentives, so only the clearly identified tokenized-equity spot volume is treated as financially substantive and the total ecosystem activity is discounted for contamination.

institutional_demand.interpretation: ETF creations and a public-company treasury purchase are direct external demand channels for SOL. They are not evidence of selective on-chain wallet convergence and therefore do not substitute for the wallet-quality leg.

leadership_rotation.value_capture: Raydium protocol documentation routes 12% of swap fees from CLMM/CPMM/AMM v4 pools to open-market RAY buybacks. Bought-back RAY is held rather than burned.
leadership_rotation.interpretation: RAY is a more direct high-beta beneficiary of the identified Solana tokenized-equity trading migration than SOL because Raydium is the dominant venue and swap fees mechanically fund RAY purchases.

structural_gate_ray.sellability: PASS; active liquid markets and observed sells.
structural_gate_ray.mint_authority: PASS; revoked according to current Solana token scanners.
structural_gate_ray.freeze_authority: PASS; revoked according to current Solana token scanners.
structural_gate_ray.liquidity: PASS for portfolio sizing; broad market liquidity and ~$72.95M 24h token turnover.
structural_gate_ray.concentration: FAIL; a project-controlled set of five vaults reportedly holds ~282.66M RAY (~50.9% of total supply), and the fee-buyback wallet reportedly holds ~86.25M RAY under one key. Bought-back tokens are not burned. Even though project vaults were reported inactive since 2024, this concentration/control overhang violates the hard gate.
structural_gate_ray.incentive_supply: Reserve-funded incentive programs distributed ~620.8K RAY over the latest 90-day period in the cited monitor; the mint itself is disabled.
structural_gate_ray.decision: No paper RAY position may be opened while this concentration/control condition remains a hard-gate failure.

structural_gate_sol.liquidity: Deep; CoinGecko aggregates SOL across 152 exchanges / 399 markets.
structural_gate_sol.supply: No hard maximum supply; protocol inflation remains an economic dilution consideration, but no arbitrary third-party SPL mint/freeze authority applies to native SOL.
structural_gate_sol.value_capture: Solana currently burns 50% of base transaction fees; 100% of priority fees go to validators. Increased activity therefore creates some native fee-burn/staking economics but not a full protocol buyback.
structural_gate_sol.decision: HOLD existing paper SOL. Do not add yet because selective-wallet confirmation is still missing and SOL is already ~10.23% of NAV.

wallet_quality.ray: No fresh cohort of historically selective, independently funded RAY accumulators verified. Protocol buybacks are deterministic value-capture flow, not discretionary smart-wallet evidence.
wallet_quality.sol: DeFi Development Corp purchases and ETF flows are real external demand but do not establish independent on-chain selective-wallet convergence. No new qualifying cohort verified.

attention_quality.detail: Tokenized-equity attention is supported by multiple independent product/regulatory and market-usage developments, including the SEC's September 17 innovation exemption. Adjacent StonkFun/Stocklana promotion and reward programs can inflate some Solana/Raydium attention and are discounted rather than treated as confirmation.

paper_portfolio_action.reason: The identified regime is real enough to alert, but RAY fails a hard concentration/control gate and SOL has not met the previously stated missing selective-wallet confirmation condition for an add.
